fields.label: Title
fields.description: The one line an employee reads on Home. Say the thing, not the category.

fields.label: Category
fields.description: Drives the colour and the icon. Nothing else.

fields.label: Pinned
fields.description: Keeps this at the top. Only one announcement may be pinned at a time.

fields.label: Require acknowledgement
fields.description: Adds an 'I've read and understood this' button, and keeps the card on the employee's Home until they press it. For policies and safety notices, not for a canteen closure.

fields.label: Urgent
fields.description: Shows above the check-in card and cannot be put off with Remind me later.

fields.label: Notify on publish
fields.description: Sends one phone notification (title + summary) when it is published.

fields.label: Which one
fields.description: The company, department or branch name this is for. A plain name rather than a Link: a Dynamic Link resolves its target doctype during Frappe's _validate_links(), which runs before every controller hook, so a target derived from `audience` can never be set in time — verified on the bench, 22 Sep 2026. The fence compares names (api/announcements.audience_matches).

fields.label: Show until
fields.description: Defaults to two weeks out. It disappears on its own, so nobody has to remember to delete it.

fields.label: Summary
fields.description: One or two plain sentences (max 140 characters). Shown on the Home card and as the phone notification. No formatting.

fields.label: Cover image
fields.description: Optional. A small picture on the Home card.

fields.label: Body
fields.description: Sanitised before it reaches the app.

fields.label: Published
fields.description: Nothing reaches an employee until this is ticked.

fields.label: Minor fix (don't ask people to confirm again)
fields.description: Tick for a typo fix. Otherwise, changing a must-read notice asks everyone to confirm the new text.
